narr: Numerous showers and thunderstorms, many of which had heavy rain, developed in a moist and unstable environment across central NC. A series of thunderstorms developed over Davidson and Randolph Counties with multiple rounds of heavy rain that produced radar estimates of 2 to 5 inches of rain. Flash flooding was reported in eastern Davidson and western and central Randolph County with several roads closed.
ev: Several roads were reported flooded in eastern Davidson County, generally north of Tabernacle and south of Thomasville.
Several roads were reported flooded near Randleman, including Fox Street and Poplar Street.
Flash flooding was reported in the 4900 block of Edgar Road.
lsr: SEVERAL ROADS BRIEFLY FLOODED IN EASTERN DAVIDSON COUNTY, NORTH OF TABERNACLE AND SOUTH OF THOMASVILLE.
